product_metadata.title: Garden Girl USA Full Dungaree/Bibpants, 6-Inch, Roses Tan
features: Wonderfit vertical spandex panels offer a sleek look with plenty of "give" for easy movement
A multitude of multi-sized pockets for your phone, tools, gloves, shades and anything else you're toting around
Internal kneepad pockets so you can move freely; Once you insert your kneepads, the protection goes wherever you do and there's no need to remove them
Fully adjustable hook-and-loop ankle straps to alter leg length and create a seal against the elements
Reinforced, double-stitched seams and easy-clean nylon spandex knee, leg bottoms and pocket panels for in-the-dirt durability
description: These trimming online best sellers just keep getting better. Equipped with Garden Girl's signature Wonderfit side stretch panels, our flattering bib overalls provide ultimate comfort and flex for the active gardener. Plus, these beauts are loaded with all the right features in all the right places, including adjustable ankle straps and pockets galore (even ones for kneepads). We know, we know. We had you at "trimming.".
